newsitem.title: GERMANY: SGL Carbon to issue new capital.
newsitem.headline: SGL Carbon to issue new capital.

text.p: FRANKFURT, March 11 (Reuter ) - German carbon and graphite maker SGL Carbon AG said on Tuesday, it plans to prepare itself for new acquisitions by asking shareholders to allow it to issue new capital.

The Wiesbaden-based group said on Tuesday that it would ask its shareholders at the annual meeting on April 21 to allow the group to issue warrants and/or convertible bonds for a volume of up to 300 million marks with a maturity of up to 10 years.

Shareholders would also be asked to approve an additional capital connected with the issue of warrants or convertible bonds with a total nominal volume of up to 10 million marks or up to two million new shares.
The group also said it planned to use part of her authorised capital in order to fulfil some of its incentive programmes for senior managers in the company.
SGL Carbon said the warrant or convertible bond issues could also be made in other currencies and that the shareholders' permission would be valid to 2002.
SGL Carbon has always said it planned to grow through new takeovers.
